title: Rob Lowe Reveals Why He Never Dated Madonna on ‘Andy Cohen Live’
summary: The actor also discusses his new movie, upcoming third book, and his infamous 1989 Oscars musical number.
body_markdown:
[Rob Lowe](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/rob-lowe) revealed that he once came close to dating[Madonna](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/madonna) , but a decision not to hit the dance floor may have cost him his chance.


[Andy Cohen Live One-of-a-kind celebrity interviews Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogRobLoweACL-RadioAndy)


During an appearance on[Radio Andy](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/radio-andy) ’s *Andy Cohen Live* to promote his new film, *The Musical* , Rob recalled making plans to meet Madonna at a party at New York City’s Limelight celebrating one of her albums.


When the “Queen of Pop” headed to the dance floor, Rob stayed behind.


“The next thing I knew, she was married to Sean Penn,” Rob told Andy. “Missed it. I was this close.”


Listen to the full show on Radio Andy (Ch. 101) on the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogRobLoweACL-RadioAndy) , and watch a clip from it now below.


### Rob Lowe Announces His Third Book


Rob also revealed that he has written a third book, which he said will be officially announced this week.


The upcoming project follows his memoirs *Stories I Only Tell My Friends* and *Love Life* , but Rob teased that readers should expect something different this time.


“It’s in a different genre,” he said.


### Rob Lowe Looks Back at His Infamous Oscars Opening


Rob also revisited his much-discussed musical number with Snow White at the 1989 Academy Awards.


Decades later, Rob joked that he’s still “dragged” for the performance and “there should be a statute of limitations.”
